name: Frigorific-Arete
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by ancient meteor crater. Beyond towering mountain ranges, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Regular pulses leave ancient alien ruins aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
